title: Module 8: Swarm Intelligence & Autonomous Robotics
description: Understanding how ant colonies and bird flocks execute highly complex global tasks using simple local rules, and how this applies to autonomous drone swarms.

learning_objectives.statement: Explain why centralized control creates a single point of failure, and how biological swarms avoid it
State the three Reynolds boid rules as local vector operations and compute a steering vector by hand
Derive why ant stigmergy converges on the shortest path using the pheromone deposition and evaporation equations
Translate a biological coordination strategy into a formal local-rule algorithm using the four-step transfer template
Evaluate when a real engineered swarm will stay robust and when local rules break down

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
